symptoms: Water-soaked pale green patches that turn brown-black within days
White fungal growth on the underside of leaves in humid weather
Fruit turns brown and firm, then rots

severity_cues.early: Isolated water-soaked patches after wet weather
severity_cues.advanced: Rapid field-wide browning, white sporulation under leaves, fruit rot

favorable_conditions: Cool nights (10 to 15 C), days around 20 to 23 C, high humidity, rain and fog, dense canopy

treatment.summary: Act within 24 hours: remove infected plants and spray an oomycete-specific fungicide on schedule
steps: Uproot and destroy infected plants, bag and remove them from the field
Spray Cymoxanil 8 percent plus Mancozeb 64 percent WP at 3.0 g per litre
Repeat spray every 5 to 7 days while wet weather continues
Improve drainage and avoid evening irrigation

products.name: Cymoxanil 8 percent plus Mancozeb 64 percent WP
products.label_source: CIB&RC registered label, waiting period 14 days

products.name: Metalaxyl 8 percent plus Mancozeb 64 percent WP
products.label_source: CIB&RC registered label, waiting period 14 days

organic: Copper oxychloride 50 WP at 2.5 to 3.0 g per litre before infection spreads
Destroy volunteer tomato and potato plants near the field

source.org: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection, tomato diseases
source.title: Tomato: late blight management

safety_notes: Wear gloves, mask and full sleeves while spraying
Do not harvest within 14 days of spray, longer than most sprays, plan harvest date first
